574-862-5006-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Crimson Kobolds is starting in your graveyard.
574-862-5006-8170.description:
Cast Crimson Kobolds by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Crimson Kobolds spell. Then, activate Vish Kal by sacrificing Crimson Kobolds, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Vish Kal equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Repeat.
574-862-5006-8170.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

574-1445-4871-6351.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
574-1445-4871-6351.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Teval triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Vish Kal ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.
574-1445-4871-6351.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

147-3085-3967.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-3085-3967.description:
Cast Zombify by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Zombify.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Zombify
Resolve the Zombify copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

4050-4364-7917.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
4050-4364-7917.description:
Declare Aurelia and Seluma as attackers. Aurelia triggers, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Aurelia.
Deal combat damage using Seluma. Seluma triggers, returning Aurelia from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3908-4284.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3908-4284.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Spark Double and Clone each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Spark Double trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Clone trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3908-4284.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

412-2511-3081-3817.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Ancestor's Chosen.
When Ancestor's Chosen dies, Orah triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Ancestor's Chosen from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 7 life.
When Ancestor's Chosen enters, it triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each card in your graveyard.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
When Sister Hospitaller dies, Orah triggers, allowing you to return a Cleric with mana value 5 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

500-804-2081-3191.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Sakashima the Impostor and creating two token copies of it that are nonlegendary copies of Kairi.
When Sakashima the Impostor dies, it triggers.
Holding priority, cast Culling the Weak by paying {B} and sacrificing one of the Sakashima the Impostor tokens.
When the token dies, it triggers. Choose either mode.
Resolve Culling the Weak, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Sakashima the Impostor trigger from step 5, causing you to mill six cards and return Saw in Half and Culling the Weak from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat
500-804-2081-3191.notes: The additional Kairi trigger in step 4 can be used to put all instants and sorceries from your library and graveyard into your hand, or to bounce permanents.

851-4682-7132.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger more than once.
851-4682-7132.description:
Activate Super-Skrull's fourth ability by paying {5}{U}, causing an opponent to draw four cards.
Smothering Tithe triggers four times, causing you to create two Treasure tokens for each time the opponent cannot pay for the trigger.
Activate six Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{U}.
Repeat.
851-4682-7132.notes:
If the opponent can pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger more times, you can still perform the combo if you have enough mana to outlast their mana supply. You can also continue this combo for other opponents if mana allows.
The extra mana can be used to activate any of Super-Skrull's abilities.

2113-2836-3832.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
2113-2836-3832.description:
Activate Puresight Merrow by tapping it, adding {W/U}.
Activate Puresight Merrow by paying {W/U} and untapping it, exiling the top card of your library.
Repeat until your deck is empty
Draw a card, causing you to win the game due to Laboratory Maniac.

2921-4605-4681-7260.description:
Cast Nature's Rhythm from your hand by paying {5}{G}{G} or from your graveyard for its harmonize cost by paying at most {5}{G}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Karmic Guide and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning an applicable target from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Karmic Guide that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Karmic Guide token enters, it triggers, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

3368-6556-6974.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four creatures with power 4 or greater.
3368-6556-6974.description:
Cast Ashling's Command by paying {U}{R} due to Temur Battlecrier. Choose its fourth mode targeting yourself and then any other mode as desired.
Holding priority, cast Reiterate with buyback by paying {R}{R} due to Temur Battlecrier, copying Ashling's Command with the fourth mode targeting yourself and returning Reiterate to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Ashling's Command, creating two Treasure tokens and performing the action of the other chosen mode.
Holding priority, activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

338-3490-4268-5231.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-3490-4268-5231.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Light of Promise attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

2178-5256-6478-6730.notablePrerequisites: There are at least X counters on artifacts, creatures and/or enchantments you control, where X is 3 plus the number of times you've cast Sin from the command zone this game.
2178-5256-6478-6730.description:
Cast Sin either from your hand or command zone by paying {5}{G}{U} plus commander tax if applicable.
As Sin enters, remove all counters from all artifacts, enchantments and creatures you control, putting twice that many +1/+1 counters on Sin.
Activate Arbor Adherent by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} or {U} equal to Sin's toughness.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Sin.
Choose to return Sin to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Sin dies, it and Arbor Adherent trigger.
Resolve the Sin trigger, putting its counters on Arbor Adherent.
Resolve the Arbor Adherent trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

requires.n: Legendary Creature with Flying and MV >= 4

2533-5925-6797--70.description:
During your precombat main phase, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the legendary creature with flying.
When the creature dies, Jackdaw Savior triggers, returning Loyal Retainers from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Loyal Retainers by sacrificing it, returning the legendary creature with flying from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a +1/+1 counter on it and has lifelink

701-4613-4968.description:
Activate Ajani's Pridemate by using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life due to its lifelink.
Ajani's Pridemate triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2498-3591-4067-6282.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2498-3591-4067-6282.description:
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card.
Necropotence triggers, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Sheoldred triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability.
Repeat.

719-1399-1606-2404.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures.
719-1399-1606-2404.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Gaea's Cradle.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.

141-1744.manaNeeded: {2}{U}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
141-1744.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
You have enough mana to cast Rite of Replication
141-1744.description:
Cast Rite of Replication by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{U}{U} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Rite of Replication, targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Rite of Replication, creating a token copy of Naru Meha.
Put either Naru Meha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat from step 3.

147-167-2438.description:
Cost Not Dead After All by paying {B}, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Not Dead After All, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Not Dead After All.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield with a Wicked Role token attached to it.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Not Dead After All, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Not Dead After All.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it and the Wicked Role token attached to it trigger.
Resolve the Wicked Role trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a Wicked Role token attached to it.
Repeat from step 7.

5231-5972-5973.easyPrerequisites:
Griffin Guide attached to another creature you control.
You control an additional creature beyond those included above and the one that has Griffin Guide attached.
5231-5972-5973.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the creature with Griffin Guide attached.
When the creature dies, Cass and Griffin Guide trigger.
Resolve the Griffin Guide trigger, creating a 2/2 Griffin creature token.
Resolve the Cass trigger, returning Griffin Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
Repeat.

575-622-2034.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Forest.
575-622-2034.description:
Activate the Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Kamahl's first ability by paying {1}{G}, causing the Forest to become a 1/1 Elemental until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Forest, adding {C}{C}.
When the Forest dies, Yedora triggers, returning the Forest land from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Repeat.

2232-3519-4783.notablePrerequisites: Your commander is on the battlefield and is a nonartifact creature with mana value 5 or greater.
2232-3519-4783.description:
Activate Food Chain by exiling your commander, adding at least six {R} that can only be spent to cast creature spells.
Choose to return your commander to the command zone from exile.
Cast Hellkite Charger by paying {4}{R}{R}.
When Hellkite Charger enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Hellkite Charger trigger, putting your commander onto the battlefield from the command zone.
When your commander enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Hellkite Charger from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
If your commander has mana value 6 or greater, this combo nets infinite colored mana that can only be spent to cast creature spells.

1046-1479-2638.notablePrerequisites: You have a basic Forest in hand.
1046-1479-2638.description:
Play a basic Forest card from your hand.
Kodama and Tireless Tracker's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield from your hand.
Holding priority, activate the basic Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating a Clue artifact token.
When the Clue token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers.
Holding priority, activate Living Twister's second ability by paying {G}, returning the Forest from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting the Forest onto the battlefield from your hand.
When the Forest enters the battlefield, Tireless Tracker triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

565-2430-2670-3941.description:
Cast Petals of Insight and splice Psychic Puppetry onto it, paying {4}{U}{U}, targeting Coveted Jewel.
Orvar triggers, creating a copy of Coveted Jewel.
The Coveted Jewel copy enters the battlefield, drawing three cards.
Resolve Petals of Insight, untapping the original Coveted Jewel, putting the top three cards of your library on the bottom of your library, and returning Petals of Insight to your hand.
Tap Coveted Jewel for {U}{U}{U}.
Tap the Coveted Jewel copy for {U}{U}{U}.
Repeat.

317-4050-4186.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
317-4050-4186.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature, adding one mana of any color.
Mazirek triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Repeat.
